title: The Hockey Omega's Second Fated Mark
story: Liam is the spare Omega on his hockey team, and for a long time he has been quietly in love with the captain, Caleb. When a tactics board comes down during practice and Liam throws himself in front of it, their fated marks touch for one second. Caleb denies him in front of the whole team and severs the bond with his own hands. Liam is left to take the bullying that follows, and the pressure waiting for him at home, until his mark finally goes dark.

title: She Came Back With His Triplets
story: Six years ago Annelise was driven out of the family she married into, branded a cheater, and left to raise triplets alone. She comes back for a divorce, and Archibald meets her at the airport with lawyers, set on keeping her children. Her three geniuses fight his men off. Then he sees his own eyes in her son and wants all four. He does not know a fourth child survived that night, stolen by his father and declared dead.

title: Mommy, Marry My Dad!
story: Four-year-old Mia is looking for a mommy, or rather a wife for her father Victor, and she spots Elena, CEO of Wilson Group. It happens that Elena is in need of a husband, for her family trust requires her to get married. Since Mia reminds her of her lost daughter, she marries Victor right away. And Victor, in the disguise of a broke retired soldier, is in fact head of a defense industry megacorp. He helps Elena deal with her scheming step-mother and other relatives, and the family grow to love each other more, eventually uncovering they're a real family to begin with.

title: 黄金の本～幸運をもたらした厄介者～
story: 五年前の自動車事故で、一族の南部地区を率いるケイン・ウォルトンは車椅子の生活を余儀なくされていた。幸運の星を迎えに行った彼が連れてこられたのは、親族から「厄介者」と呼ばれる六歳の少女メイヴだった。傷だらけで臆病な彼女は、彼女にしか見えない黄金の物語の本を持っていた。ケインと妻のセリアは彼女を養子に迎える。捨てられた少女が、彼の壊れた足を治し、家族内の毒殺計画を暴くとは、誰も予想していなかった。「捨てられたその少女が、人生を変えてくれた。」

title: The Secret of Gala Night
story: To repay her debts, Elena was forced to work as a waitress at a luxury yacht party. In the dim lower deck, she accidentally had a one-night stand with Dominic Kane, the heir of a top wealthy family who had been drugged and was barely conscious. The pitch-black night hid their faces from each other, and they parted ways without ever knowing who the other was. The next day, Elena was inexplicably fired, leaving her utterly desperate. To make a living, she applied to become the personal nanny for a five-year-old boy named Leo, unaware that her employer was the very man from that night, the true head of the Kane Group, Dominic.

title: He Lost Her, Then He Learned The Truth
story: To save her fated mate Ethan, Lianne burns her wolf soul and cuts herself to cure him, only to receive years of cold neglect. On their anniversary, pregnant and in a car crash, she finds him with his first love Ivy. She hides a mate-rejection letter inside a document and makes him sign it. A week later, the bond breaks, and she leaves with her child. The overlooked chief secretary is actually a brilliant jewelry designer. As she reclaims her art and her worth, her old friend, superstar Frank, stands by her. Ethan, now jealous and full of regret, watches her go, while Ivy's lie about saving his life begins to unravel. When his late love finally catches up to her new life, will Lianne turn back?

title: Betrayed By Beasts Wed To Dragon
story: Vera, heiress of Silvermoon City, gives twenty years of devotion to five beastmen she saved from the fighting pits, only for all of them to betray her under Selina, a maidservant's daughter. Heartbroken, she marries the infamous northern Dragon Lord Draven. Selina's schemes unravel at the wedding and she tries to kill Vera, but Draven saves her through their sympathetic connection. The traitors are punished, and Vera finds lasting happiness with Draven, her childhood savior.

title: Reborn to Kiss the Ruthless Mafia Boss
story: I was reborn after being taken by a mafia boss. This time? No more running. I kissed him, borrowed his blade, and wiped out my whole family.

title: Forsaken by the Pack, Mated to the Secret Lycan King
story: Tormented omega Adelina's inner wolf has never awakened, and she is cast aside when Alpha Jesse names Kira his Fated Luna. Threatened with losing her trust fund, she buys a one-year sham marriage, only to discover reclusive Lycan Alpha King Kane Blackwell posing as exile Beau. Their contract forbids intimacy and mating marks, yet Kane's protection helps Adelina reclaim her estate and hotel shares. As Jesse's obsession, Kira's traps, and family betrayals endanger her, Adelina uncovers Kane's secrets, including a mysterious A.W. tattoo, and must decide whether their bond is cold politics or destined love.

title: The Bond He Severed
story: At Moonlight Crown Academy, low-ranking student Alina is rejected by her longtime crush, Eden, who severs their magical bond and leaves her powerless. His estranged brother Raine takes her in, and her magic begins to awaken around him. Though Eden later confesses his love, Alina moves on. A sage reveals that whoever awakened her magic stands above all talent ranks, leaving Raine's true power and connection to Alina a mystery.

title: One Night With A Racer, Two Wolf Cubs
story: After one reckless night with racing star Dean, Katie gives birth to twins who turn out to be wolf cubs. To protect them, she hides the truth alone. But her mischievous daughter Nicole and gentle son Felix are determined to find their father and reunite the family. Dean feels an inexplicable closeness to the cubs, yet jealousy, debt, and lies keep tearing them apart. What Katie doesn't know is that the father is hiding a secret too, he's a werewolf.

title: Oops! The President Fell For A Cleaning Lady
story: Elena, a 47-year-old refugee, works as a hotel cleaner and raises her son Ethan alone. Facing a 24-hour deportation notice, she still wants to see his wedding to billionaire heiress Hannah Green. In the alley, she saves President August from assassination. Hiding his identity as a bodyguard, he marries her to keep her in the country. At the wedding, Ethan denies her, and the Greens humiliate her, but August settles scores for her. Ethan later kidnaps her for ransom and is shot dead, exposing August's presidency. Elena asks for divorce over their status gap, but August wins her back as an ordinary man. In the end, they hold a wedding and return to the beach where they met.

title: His Cure, His Destined
story: Four years ago, Emma shared a night with Ethan. Then she gave birth to their son Leo, who suffers from a rare disease. Four years later, Emma works as a caregiver to pay for Leo's treatment. By chance, she is hired by Ethan's grandma to take care of him, because Ethan has been paralyzed by a car accident. Ethan is irritable at first, but Emma's gentle care softens him. As the two get closer, an awkward demand from Ethan's grandma disrupts the peace, and gives a schemer the chance to intervene. The family must overcome schemes, sickness, and misunderstandings to truly reunite.

title: ‫ليلة مع المتسابق وشبلان من الذئاب‬
story: ‫بعد ليلة متهورة مع نجم السباقات دين، تلد كاتي توأمين يتبين أنهما شبلان ذئبان. ولحمايتهما، تخفي الحقيقة بمفردها. لكن ابنتها الشقية وابنها اللطيف مصممان على العثور على والدهما وإعادة لم شمل الأسرة. يشعر دين بقرب لا يمكن تفسيره تجاه الشبلين، لكن الغيرة والديون والأكاذيب تستمر في التسبب في تفككهم. ما لا تعرفه كاتي هو أن الأب يخفي سرًا هو الآخر، فهو ذئب متحول.‬

title: Daddy, Will You Love Me?
story: Five years ago, diagnosed with cancer, Claire had to break up with her boyfriend Black. To spare him from pain, Claire lied that she was marrying a richer man, and the two parted bitterly. After the breakup, Claire discovered she was pregnant, and passed away shortly after giving birth to Daisy. Daisy was sent to an orphanage, with only a box left from Claire. On Christmas Eve, little Daisy called her father, Black. Unaware of the truth, Black cursed Daisy as a "bastard" and drove her out of the house. Yet soon, unable to bear it, Black brought Daisy back home as she stood in the heavy snow rummaging through a trash can. Black treated Daisy harshly, until Daisy's box spilled open. The moment he learned Daisy was his own daughter, remorse and guilt finally overwhelmed him.

title: Came Back Hotter With Lord's Twins
story: Jodi carried the blood of dragonslayers and an ugly birthmark. Her fiancé Paul abandoned her for it. Then she met Nick, the Lord of the Burning Realm, cursed to burn alive for a century. Her touch was the only thing that could stop the fire. One night, she walked away pregnant with twins. Five years later, Jodi returned to the Dragon Lands for her daughters. Her mark faded, her face changed, and she became unrecognizable. But Melody had poisoned Nick's mind with lies, and her own family attacked her at every turn. When Nick finally uncovered the truth, he found his fated mate in the woman he'd wronged. They tore through conspiracies, saved their daughters, and claimed each other.

title: Cheer Camp Hell: My Coach Boyfriend Locked Me In
story: They called it a fake faint. One locked metal shed, one hundred and twenty degrees Fahrenheit, and Ember's pounding on the door went unanswered. Her boyfriend, the leopard coach, chose the fox rival's lie over the medical report she'd sent him. Then the chain clicked shut—and something impossible opened instead. Not a rescue. A second run on the very same day. This time the quiet girl isn't begging. She's holding proof, a phone, and a bottle nobody checked.

title: I’m Done Being Your Mafia Princess
story: After discovering she is adopted, the once-pampered heir of the Vareso mafia family becomes docile. She yields everything to her jealous sister Rena, even her boyfriend. But when betrayal deepens, she decides to break free and stop being their obedient mafia princess.

title: They Crossed The Wrong Mafia Heir
story:
When a secret mafia heir travels to meet his arranged fiancée… a yacht crash unleashes brutal underworld reckoning.
Public humiliation, a sister’s explosive rescue, and a ruthless power grab.

title: The Fox Clan Cast Me Out,The Phoenixes Crowned Me Princess.
story: Born too strong into a Fox Clan that worships fragile beauty, Stella is despised, betrayed, and left to die in the snow. Reborn on mate-selection day, she rejects every strong warrior and chooses the dying outcast raven in the corner—the one nobody dares touch. The moment their hands meet, gold light flares. He knows what her family buried eighteen years ago: she was never a fox, but the stolen Snow Phoenix princess. Now, with a phoenix lord at her side, she will reclaim her power and make them

title: The Mafia Queen's 200-Pound Husband
story: A burly, kind‑hearted man gets cast out by his ex‑wife. He rescues a traumatized little girl from kidnappers, catching the eye of her powerful wheelchair‑bound mafia‑family mother. Hired as her live‑in cook, he enters a fake contract marriage to comfort the child. As they stand against scheming rivals, the girl’s biological father’s custody fight, and hidden conspiracies, their pretend bond gradually blooms into sincere, genuine love and a real family.

title: After being adopted by four bad boys, I raised them to become legendary figures.
story: After taking in four troubled boys, a determined young woman gives them the home and guidance they never had. Years later, they become powerful, celebrated men—but none has forgotten the woman who changed their lives. As old wounds resurface and their bond is tested, she must decide whether she can still reach the family she built.

title: Perfect Family Photo Without Me
story: Despite winning a top scholarship, Lucia is relegated to a storage closet and cut from the family photo while her divorced parents, brother, and childhood crush all favor her sister, nearly ruining her enrollment. Heartbroken, Lucia walks away, becoming a successful architect and finding true family in friends. Rejecting her blood family's late apologies, she buys her grandfather’s house, finally owning a door keyed only to her fingerprint.

title: The Hockey Star's Contract Cruise Fiancée
story: Emilia is planning her wedding when her fiancé and best friend run off together. Her best friend is already pregnant and married to him, yet the pair still expect Emilia to serve as their bridesmaid at the cruise wedding and cover the remaining costs. Her friend Tessa hatches a plan for payback, and Emilia signs a contract with hockey star Liam before boarding the ship on his arm. He spends the entire voyage shutting down every guest who sneers at her. What no one on the cruise knows is that she is the heir to a vast family fortune.

title: Their Perfect Four Left Me Behind
story: On graduation night, Lena realizes that the future she imagined with her boyfriend and closest friends no longer reflects who she wants to become. Ready to choose her own path, she leaves the country with her father and joins a five-year aerospace program. Surrounded by new opportunities, Lena rediscovers her confidence, develops her talents, and builds a life defined by purpose. When her former friends finally see her again, the girl they once overlooked has become a celebrated scientist with a

title: No More Wife — I’m Falcone’s Heir
story: Mia, a new mother, is mistreated by her husband Leo and humiliated by Vera, who takes her baby. After a desperate call, her uncle Roman, a powerful Falcone family tycoon, rescues her and brings Leo and Vera to justice. Mia rebuilds herself into a ruthless business partner and reclaims her daughter and freedom.

title: La Obsesión Gordita del Alfa
story: Humillada públicamente por su compañero predestinado debido a su cuerpo y a no tener lobo, Aina creyó que su destino estaba sellado. Sin embargo, cuando el desprecio de la manada amenazaba con destruirla, Osborne, el temido hijo del Alfa, irrumpe para salvarla y marcarla ferozmente como suya. Aunque él la ha amado en secreto durante diez años, las garras de la envidia acechan. ¿Qué poderoso linaje esconde Aina que pondrá de rodillas a quienes la humillaron? (78 palabras)

title: Фейерверк мести
story: Эйвери замужем за Хорхе три года. Но когда дело доходит до долгожданной свадьбы, он требует развода, чтобы жениться на Ребекке — девушке, которая якобы спасла ему жизнь. Эйвери подписывает документы и уходит. На обочине её едва не сбивает машина, но в последний момент её спасает Брайан — её возлюбленный из детства, который тут же делает ей предложение. Она соглашается и начинает подготовку к конкурсу фейерверков. Эйвери намерена вернуть карьеру гениального дизайнера и сокрушить Ребекку-плагиаторшу. Хорхе не может её забыть, а его бабушка поддерживает её, но теперь знаменитый дизайнер хочет только новую счастливую жизнь с Брайаном.

title: ดวงตาที่เธอมอบให้เจ้าพ่อผู้มืดบอด
story: เจนนี่เผลอมีสัมพันธ์ชั่วข้ามคืนกับเลียม เจ้าพ่อมาเฟียตาบอดจนตั้งครรภ์ แต่เพราะความเข้าใจผิด เขาจึงทอดทิ้งเธอ ต่อมาเธอจำต้องบริจาคกระจกตาเพื่อแลกกับค่าผ่าตัดให้แม่ ซึ่งผู้รับกลับเป็นเลียม เมื่อเขาช่วยเธอจากการถูกพ่อบุญธรรมใจร้ายขายให้เจ้าหนี้ เจนนี่จึงลุกขึ้นสู้และยอมใช้อาวุธปกป้องเขา ในที่สุดทั้งคู่ก็คลี่คลายความเข้าใจผิดและได้แต่งงานกันในที่สุด

title: Devenir la Reine du Don, mon ex-beau-père
story: Isabella est abandonnée devant l'autel par son fiancé, Alex. Pour sauver sa dignité et se venger, elle épouse le père d'Alex, Damien, le chef suprême de la mafia. Après le mariage, grâce à son esprit vif et à son influence grandissante, elle anéantit son ex, reprend l'héritage pillé de sa mère, écrase les trahisons familiales, et passe d'une mariée abandonnée à une souveraine de la mafia. Au fil du temps, un mariage contractuel froid avec Damien se transforme en quelque chose de réel, une passion ardente et irrésistible.

title: Ona Köle Dediler, O Yönetti
story: Vampirler yüzyıllar boyunca insanları hüküm altında tuttu. Elara yarı kanlı biriydi; dilsiz taklidi yapıyor, gizlice yasaklı bir şifacı ve dark-web şifre çözücüsü olarak kendisini eziyet eden aileden gördüğü eziyetin intikamını planlıyordu. Görevini gerçekleştirmek için ziyafete sızdı ve zehirlenmiş safkan General Dorian'ı kurtardı. Dorian'a kan kölesi olarak verildiğinde bir hayır galasında safkan elitleri alt etti, tahvilleri açığa satarak annesinin mezarını geri satın aldı, sessizliğini bozdu ve servetinin kilidini açtı. Birlikte zehir komplosunu, kan sözleşmesi defterini ve gerçeği açığa çıkardılar: Isadora annesini öldürmüştü. Dorian Elara'yı kurtarmak için gücünün yarısını feda etti. Sonrasında Elara safkanlardan daha güçlü, kadim bir ata olarak uyandı...

title: I Became a Mafia Boss Stepmother the Night I Got Dumped
story: Ava is dumped by her bankrupt fiancé. Desperate, she works as a caregiver for crime boss Dario Moretti’s two traumatized children. She heals the kids, and Dario proposes a marriage of convenience. Ava confronts her ex and reclaims her family’s assets. The cold mansion becomes a home, and their fake love turns real. She finds home where she is wanted.

title: Oops! My Dream Boyfriend Is the Hockey Captain
story:
Mila has a secret: she can slip into people’s dreams. Trying to reach her childhood crush, she accidentally crashes into the dreams of Ronan—the university's cold, brooding hockey captain!
Forced to work together after being the team’s intern trainer, Mila quickly falls for Ronan. As old crushes fade and hidden pasts surface, she discovers Ronan has secretly loved and protected her for years. When dreams collide with reality at the finals, will she claim the captain’s heart?

title: The Surrogate Vampire Princess's Revenge
story: After her clan is slaughtered by the Vaughn family, vampire princess Tina returns with a new face and a thirst for revenge. Forced to become the surrogate of the barren Vaughn heiress Ashley, Tina is used to win over billionaire heir Lexi. But revenge takes an unexpected turn when Lexi falls for Tina... and she becomes pregnant with his child. When the Vaughns discover Tina's true identity, they set a deadly trap to eliminate her. As old blood feuds reignite, Lexi must choose between his family and the woman he loves, while an ancient war between vampires and demon hunters threatens to consume them all.

title: My Vampire Husband's Double Life
story: I was just a maid in the house—until they forced me to marry a man in a coma. They said it was just a formality. They said he'd never wake up. But the moment I touched his abs… He opened his eyes. Worse yet, his younger brother tried to claim me while he was “unconscious.” But I had no idea—the real monster hadn't even woken up yet. The man I married… is the King of Vampires. And when he wakes up, no one gets out alive.

title: Starving in the Serpent Warlord’s Tower
story: Starving and pregnant, Liora takes a secret job to pay for an abortion—until she overhears her husband, the feared Serpent Warlord, claim he gives her a fortune every month. If the money never reached her, who stole it—and what else have they kept from him?

title: Fruit Twins: The Don’s Contract Bride
story: Betrayed by her family and framed for a crime she didn't commit, heiress Chloe Thorne was forced into a shady clinic to lose her unborn children. Five years later, Chloe survives as a resilient waitress, haunted by the grief of her 'dead' twins. Little do

title: Purrfectly Faked
story: Maisie, a cat-shifter baker, and Kaelen, a wolf-shifter bassist, find themselves caught in a high-stakes deception when they impersonate their elite siblings for a seven-day engagement trial. Within the walls of Thornfield Manor, they must navigate strict

title: My Billionaire Son Picked the Junkyard Queen
story: Tired of superficial gold-diggers, billionaire CEO Marcus Sterling strikes a deal with his ten-year-old son, Leo: Leo will vet prospective stepmothers, and Marcus will marry whoever passes. Disguised as a ragged street urchin, Leo repels greedy socialites
